note: Synthetic evaluation set. Every passage is English-only so Chinese queries test true cross-language retrieval. Each query has exactly one relevant passage.

passages.text: Plants capture sunlight with chlorophyll and use that energy to turn carbon dioxide and water into sugar, releasing oxygen as a by-product.
Before two computers exchange data over TCP, they perform a three-step handshake in which each side confirms that the other is ready to send and receive.
A sourdough starter is a living culture of wild yeast and bacteria; feeding it flour and water regularly keeps it active enough to make bread rise.
A black hole is a region of space where gravity is so strong that nothing, not even light, can escape once it crosses the event horizon.
Roman engineers moved water to cities over long distances using aqueducts, relying on a gentle downhill slope so gravity did all the work.
A vaccine trains the immune system by showing it a harmless piece of a germ, so the body can recognise and fight the real infection faster later.
With compound interest, the earnings from an investment are added to the principal, so each following period grows from a larger base.
Ocean tides rise and fall mainly because the moon's gravitational pull tugs on the water, creating bulges on the near and far sides of the Earth.
Roasting coffee beans longer produces a darker colour and a more bitter, smoky taste, while light roasts keep more of the bean's original acidity.
Binary search finds an item in a sorted list by repeatedly comparing it with the middle element and discarding the half that cannot contain it.
A monsoon is a seasonal reversal of wind direction that brings heavy rainfall to South Asia in summer after months of dry weather.
Honeybees communicate the direction and distance of food by performing a waggle dance inside the hive for their nestmates.
